title: ROAD: Responsibility-Oriented Reward Design for Reinforcement Learning in Autonomous Driving
reasoning: The paper develops a reward system based on 'responsibility' and 'accident liability,' explicitly aiming to align autonomous driving agents with 'legal and ethical standards' and 'human-centric values.' It uses LLMs and VLMs to perform reasoning on responsibility (primary vs. secondary liability), which is a form of moral and legal judgment.
